Gaza Doctor Detention Raises Concerns Over Torture and Safety

Dr. Hussam Abu Safia, a prominent Gaza doctor, has been detained for over 500 days without charge or trial. His lawyer claims he was severely beaten in Israeli jail, leaving him almost unrecognizable. The international community is calling for his release due to concerns over his safety and the risk of torture.
